(2) A close-up shot shows a male patient's face with significant acne scarring on the cheek. (3) The doctor reappears, gesturing with her hands while explaining. Animated text and graphic boxes pop up around her to emphasize key phrases. (4) Close-up shot of a medical professional's gloved hand using a silver medical device (Curejet) on a patient's face. The patient is wearing protective goggles. (5) A final screen appears with a white background and the clinic's logo, phone numbers, and addresses in Taipei and New Taipei City.
